decisions: SIEZEALL account owns the active Google Cloud project, OAuth Client ID and Drive API configuration.
HNS is not a user-facing file-drop surface.
Users write/reference through the SIEZEALL shared Drive surface.

The single user reference inbox is SIEZEALL Drive folder 00_INBOX_USER (Drive ID 1upSxxdECT5MCC1fvPJFOi24kk7K0LoOB); the former F: path was an HNS-side mount assumption and is not a valid SIEZEALL local-sync binding.
The single SIEZEALL user inbox is addressed primarily by Google Drive folder ID; Windows DriveFS/local sync is an optional mirror and must not be a prerequisite for ingestion.
HNS remains the internal/admin approved-master route.
SIEZEALL remains the approved distribution and user-sync route.
GitHub and Netlify usage stays minimal; asset/data package refresh alone does not require deploy unless code/schema/slot-contract changes.
Netlify cannot determine asset identity or slot binding from filenames or deployed paths.
Asset delivery uses pre-resolved manifest/hash binding before distribution, then device-side verification/cache activation.
During fragmentation cleanup, source deletion remains HOLD until extraction, indexing and readback receipts are verified.
explicit_non_changes: Do not redefine TAKY master logic from scratch.
Do not rewrite existing Visual ID, badge, character behavior or UI verification semantics except where the storage route needs a pointer.
Do not mass-migrate or delete historical TAKY-ASSETS binaries yet.
Do not create another user inbox.

inbox_baseline.policy: preserve legacy 58-file baseline; primary remote Drive folder-ID intake tracks new/changed by Drive file ID/revision/hash; local mirror is optional
